proof:
by
  with_unfolding_all
    simp only [eq_self, true_implies, implies_true, and_true, true_and, not_true_eq_false, not_false_eq_true]
    all_goals decide +kernel
all_goals_scope: The fixed single closed theorem goal after logical normalization; if simp-only has closed it, all_goals is a no-op. It introduces no alternative prover or new compiler attempt.
theorem_type: Exact original closed E or Not E, never a normalized replacement type.
observation_oracle: Only the independently replayed safe theorem and existing exact source/statement/dependency/axiom checks, plus the transitive forbidden-oracle audit. Tactic construction is untrusted.
axioms: Record the actual used theorem axiom inventory, classify it under the existing policy and retain the exact dependency/module identities. No claim of an empty axiom set is made before execution.
proof_dependency_terminal_rule: Pinned allowed toolchain imports cannot depend forward on newly staged declarations. Audit every reached staged declaration and permit only such bound toolchain leaves. Missing staged exports are blocking.
